articles.title: Meet Saransh Jain, the MP spinner who ran riot against Bihar with a seven-wicket
articles.summary: He registered excellent figures of 7/40 from 13 overs to rattle out Bihar for just 99 runs on day one of the match. In their reply, Madhya Pradesh were 105/0 after 18 overs at the time of writing this report, having taken a six-run lead. Yash Dubey was unbeaten on 63, whereas Saksham Purohit was not out on 36.

articles.title: Mahadev Betting App Promoter Sourabh Chandrakar Extradited To India, When Is ED Going
articles.summary: The extradition of Sourabh Chandrakar from Oman to India on November 1, 2026, has reopened one of the most significant financial-crime investigations involving India’s online betting ecosystem. The return of a principal alleged promoter of the Mahadev Online Book syndicate is an important development for the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and the Enforcement Directorate (ED).
